rca_of_the_issue.problem: Hero left column had fixed h-[520px]; right side column height driven by its content — often shorter/taller than hero. This produced a visible vertical gap on the left below the hero (or unequal bottom edges), which looked like blank space before 'తాజా వార్తలు'.
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: 1) Outer hero grid: lg:h-[500px] locks both columns to same height. 2) Hero card variant: h-[420px] md:h-[520px] lg:h-full lets it fill the wrapper. 3) Right column: grid + lg:auto-rows-fr splits available height equally between the 2 side cards. 4) Default NewsCard: flex flex-col h-full with flex-shrink-0 image and flex-1 content so each cell fills its allocated row height cleanly. 5) heroSide capped at 2 items with a safe fallback.
rca_of_the_issue.verification: getBoundingClientRect measurements show heroCard.bottom === sideCol.bottom === heroGrid.bottom (all 755px). Latest News section starts 48px below (from mt-12). Zero-pixel gap on left column.
